title: I made a whole game with the help of Claude Code. Here's what I used it for, what I didn't, and a free demo
author: Agreeable_Focus7996
selftext:
I'm Csaba, a small indie dev. I always wanted to make a game on my own, and AI is the reason it was possible. GREED is a short survivor-like built in Godot 4.6 with GDScript.

How it's made, so you know what you're looking at:

* The code is written with the help of Claude Code. I decide what the game should do, read what comes back, and test it. It doesn't run itself.
* I hooked the Godot editor to it through an MCP plugin, so it can run the game, take screenshots, and read the logs. That loop (change something, run it, look at the screenshot) was the biggest speedup for me.
* The art isn't from an image model. I draw it in code with my own pixel-art tool, so it stays on one palette and one look. The tool itself was written with AI help, but no image, voice or music in the game is generated.
* Sound is my own sound tool plus some free CC0 packs by Kenney.
* I had bots play the game to check the balance instead of guessing.

I put all of that on the itch page too, because I think people should be able to see it.

If you want to see what came out of it, the demo is free and runs in your browser: [https://chubby00.itch.io/greed](https://chubby00.itch.io/greed)
